name: Kneeler Spacer
description: A thin ring spacer that fills the gap between the kneeler bushing collar and the frame. Sits flush against the bushing to prevent lateral play in the hardware.

printSettings.spacer: Polymaker PLA Pro (Burgundy) | 4 Wall Loops | 35% Gyroid Infill

assemblyGuide: Install the kneeler bushing into the frame hole first.
Slide the spacer over the hardware and seat it against the bushing collar.
The spacer fills the remaining gap between the collar and the frame surface.
